title: Minimum Time to Complete All Tasks
summary: Given a 2D integer array tasks where each task is represented as [starti, endi, durationi], indicating that the i-th task should run for a total of durationi seconds within the inclusive time range [starti, endi], determine the minimum duration the computer must be turned on to complete all tasks, turning it on only when necessary and off when idle.
statement: Given a 2D integer array tasks where each task is represented as [starti, endi, durationi], indicating that the i-th task should run for a total of durationi seconds within the inclusive time range [starti, endi], determine the minimum duration the computer must be turned on to complete all tasks, turning it on only when necessary and off when idle.
constraints: Task [start,end,duration] needs at least duration active integer seconds in its inclusive interval.
One active second may satisfy multiple tasks.
Return the minimum number of seconds the computer is active.
hints: Process tasks by increasing end time.
Count already-active seconds in the current interval and add only the remaining requirement.
Choose new seconds from the end backward so they are most likely to help later-ending tasks.
An exchange moves any earlier chosen second to a later available second without hurting processed tasks and can only help future tasks, proving greedy optimality.

tests.explanation: Activating seconds three and five satisfies all three tasks with total time two.
A minimum schedule uses four active seconds.
